description: Densely sample a narrow time window of the original video — use it when two keyframes are not enough to tell what happened between them (a flash, a transient error, the exact moment a click landed). Keep the window short: frames are returned at the requested fps.

fps.description: Frames per second inside the window. Default 4.

max_images.description: How many of the extracted frames to return inline. Default 6, ceiling 8.

session.description: Session folder from analyze_video; the original video is read from its manifest.

source.description: Video path, if you have no session.

name: zoom_clip
title: Re-extract a short window at a high frame rate
